title: More community projects in the showcase
summary:
The showcase grew, while fixes targeted model validation, tier display, Polar rate limits, and event-record reliability.

Thirteen projects were added to the showcase, spanning terminal chat, image galleries, sticker making, a LINE image bot, and PDF-to-speech. ViralFlow AI joined the creative projects list, while descriptions for existing listings became clearer. These are showcase and listing changes, not changes to the apps themselves.

The Llama 3.1 8B configuration now requests at most 4096 output tokens, below the model’s 8192-token limit. That prevents validation errors caused by the previous default.

Customer-state and tier routes now reuse cached Polar data to reduce rate-limit errors. A separate lookup fix lets the Tier panel return an active subscription’s tier name and daily Pollen allowance instead of showing “Unknown Tier” and “0 pollen/day.”
